record.scope: Persons, vehicles, goods and animals through Baymak

record.exceptions: At later19 September operation passenger cars and pedestrians permitted; trucks barred and hand baggage limited.
record.enforcement: 21 September operational follow-up records >500 people/day from19 September.
record.relationship: Local EAEU crossing rule differs from generic Uzbek 2010 closures; post-permission technical outage excluded.
record.status_observation: Simplified operation resumed September 19, 2017 after a September 16 decree and technical delay.
record.official_rationale: Compliance with international obligations under the Eurasian Economic Union, stated in Kyrgyz government decree No. 231.
record.context: Kyrgyz EAEU external-border crossing regime; suspension imposed by decreeNo231 dated6 May 2016.
record.uncertainty: May 2016 is the decree-based onset month; exact implementation day is not established. The September 16 legal decision preceded technical work, with actual limited operation reported from September 19. Trucks remained excluded.
